families.topic: acetic acid exposure and incident response
families.page_title: Acetic acid: health effects and incident management
evidence_points: The official UKHSA page provides information on acetic acid for use when responding to chemical incidents.
The page is published by the UK Health Security Agency on GOV.UK.
The publication was first published on 7 March 2011.
The GOV.UK record shows a latest update of 26 November 2024.
The publication provides general information and incident management material.
The linked material supports substance-specific assessment of health effects, exposure and incident response for acetic acid.
Acetic acid is also known as ethanoic acid.
The official page was live-opened successfully on 31 July 2026 and retained the title “Acetic acid: health effects and incident management”.
An alert, symptom, exposure report, incident notification or checklist alone does not establish that every recommendation on Acetic acid: health effects and incident management applies.

Final decisions require the current official page scope plus the exact substance, exposure route, concentration or quantity, duration, affected people, setting, measurements, clinical and operational evidence, responsible organisations, protective actions, communication, documentation and review.
